body:
Goals - Short Term

  1. Physical Fitness: Start a consistent exercise regimen, targeting 150 minutes of moderate-intensity aerobic activity per week to maintain health and manage stress.
  2. Nutrition: Aim to maintain or adopt a balanced, nutritious diet for overall health and vitality.
  3. Continued Education and Skills: Consider pursuing additional qualifications, or learning a new skill or hobby. This could range from cooking classes to obtaining a certification relevant to your job.
  4. Vacations: Save for and plan at least one dream vacation or several short trips, which could involve exploring a new culture or engaging in a favorite activity like skiing, hiking, etc.
  5. Savings: Aim to save a specific percentage of your income each month (e.g., 20%).
  6. Emergency Fund: If not already established, build an emergency fund equal to at least 3-6 months of living expenses.
